chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id narrated to us via this chain, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Zurara who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'Is the Call true?' He said: 'Yes, by Allah, until every nation hears it in its own language.' He also said: 'This matter will not occur until nine-tenths of the people perish.'

key_terms.الْأَمْرُ: The Matter (referring to the rise of the Mahdi)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the 'Call' and the 'nine-tenths' in Shia eschatology?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) affirms that the heavenly Call (Al-Nada') will be universally understood in each nation's native tongue, serving as a definitive sign of the Mahdi's appearance. This event is inextricably linked to the demographic shift where nine-tenths of humanity perish, a condition necessary for the establishment of true religious authority and the fulfillment of divine promise.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (54) Ahmad bin Muhammad bin Sa’eed narrated from the same previous narrators from Hisham bin Salim that Zurara had said:

“Once I asked Abu Abdullah as-Sadiq (as) if the call (from the Heaven) would be true. He said: “Yes, by Allah, until every nation will hear it with its own language.” He also said: “Al-Qa’im will not appear unless nine tenths of people perish.”
